entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Once again, our helicopter touched..."
entries.dialogueText: Once again, our helicopter touched down in the Meftiem International Trade Zone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena winced as she descended the s..."
entries.dialogueText: Elena winced as she descended the steps to the sandy ground.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It really is a shame we can't take..."
entries.dialogueText: "It really is a shame we can't take {RiziaDLCText.RoyalJet} here. I've gotten used to flying in style."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""The trip was quicker last time. Or..."
entries.dialogueText: "The trip was quicker last time. Or I was just younger..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She pinned a strand of grey hair be..."
entries.dialogueText: She pinned a strand of grey hair behind her ear as we began walking towards the MITZ headquarters.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Ready for the final vote, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ready for the final vote, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Remind me again. How much do we ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remind me again. How much do we have riding on this?"

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Well...""
entries.dialogueText: "Well..."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Thanks to our new gold mine in Qal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to our new gold mine in Qalus, we are much less dependent on international gold production."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Nationalizing Rizian Royal Gold ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nationalizing Rizian Royal Gold has vastly increased our income from the gold mined within our own country."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Admittedly, it is unlikely we'll f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Admittedly, it is unlikely we'll find any new gold sources in Rizia in the near future."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""But our other industries are boomi..."
entries.dialogueText: "But our other industries are booming to the extent that gold really doesn't matter to us so much anymore."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Which is troubling, because a larg..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which is troubling, because a large percentage of our economy still depends on gold."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""And honestly, our other industries..."
entries.dialogueText: "And honestly, our other industries are booming to the extent that our gold income serves as little more than icing on the proverbial cake."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Which is fortunate, because a larg..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which is fortunate, because a large percentage of our economy still depends on gold."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Between that and our new mine in Q..."
entries.dialogueText: "Between that and our new mine in Qalus, we have become much less dependent on international gold production."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I will warn you that our proposal..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will warn you that our proposal to completely forego a share in the nationalized MITZ will cause considerable financial damage if it goes through."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I will warn you that our proposal..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will warn you that our proposal to shrink our share in the MITZ will cause some financial damage if it goes through."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""So we have a vested interest in ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "So we have a vested interest in making sure the proposal we agreed on with Morella goes through."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Our proposal to completely forego..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our proposal to completely forego a share in the nationalized MITZ will still cause some financial damage if it goes through."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Our proposal to shrink our share i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our proposal to shrink our share in the MITZ will cause a small amount of financial damage if it goes through."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It will still be of some financial..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will still be of some financial benefit to us if the proposal we agreed on with Morella goes through."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""In light of that, I'd advise you t..."
entries.dialogueText: "In light of that, I'd advise you to go into this meeting with the intention of strengthening our international partnerships, rather than maximizing our returns."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""But I would advise you to go into..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I would advise you to go into this meeting with the intention of strengthening our international partnerships, not maximizing our returns."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I'd advise you to think about how..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd advise you to think about how we can maximize our returns. Even if it costs us an international partnership or two."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I fully intend to come out of this..."
entries.dialogueText: "I fully intend to come out of this building with both our gold income and our international relations intact, Ms. Werner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Morella's support is key to my pla..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella's support is key to my plans for a South Merkopan alliance. I have to keep Saltana happy at all costs."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our relations with all of our MITZ..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our relations with all of our MITZ partners are already fragile thanks to the war. I don't want to do anything to upset them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia is anchored in gold. The mor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia is anchored in gold. The more of it we have, the better. Damn the consequences."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""That was Her Majesty Queen Lyza's..."
entries.dialogueText: "That was Her Majesty Queen Lyza's mindset as well."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Then I wish you the best of luck.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then I wish you the best of luck."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""At *all* costs, Your Majesty?""
entries.dialogueText: "At *all* costs, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We're four countries with four dif..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're four countries with four differing interests. Someone will likely get upset, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We kept walking until we reached th..."
entries.dialogueText: We kept walking until we reached the entrance of the headquarters.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do you still think our proposal is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you still think our proposal is a good idea?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. It's time for Morella to get..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. It's time for Morella to get its proper due."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez had a smug expression on hi..."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez had a smug expression on his face as I took my place next to him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I made a promise to Lespia. I have..."
entries.dialogueText: "I made a promise to Lespia. I have to vote their way, no matter what Morella threatens."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I understand.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""My brothers and sisters.""
entries.dialogueText: "My brothers and sisters."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""In accordance with a majority of s..."
entries.dialogueText: "In accordance with a majority of stakeholders, we have negotiated a draft proposal for the nationalization of the Trade Zone."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Unfortunately, we could not reach..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, we could not reach a concord between stakeholders, and a new direction for the Meftiem International Trade Zone could not be determined.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I thank my partners for their gene..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thank my partners for their generosity and cooperation during this process."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""And I am happy to assure everyone..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I am happy to assure everyone gathered here that nobody will go home empty-handed."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Well... almost nobody.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well... almost nobody."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An aide approached Saltana with a b..."
entries.dialogueText: An aide approached Saltana with a briefcase. She opened it and took out a single piece of paper.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The Meftiem International Trade Zo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Meftiem International Trade Zone Nationalization Agreement of 1957."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""All currently existing assets with..."
entries.dialogueText: "All currently existing assets within the Meftiem Basin will be brought under Morellan state ownership."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""From henceforth, operations in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "From henceforth, operations in the Trade Zone will be overseen by a new state corporation, Muardien Mining and Trade."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The government of Morella will own..."
entries.dialogueText: "The government of Morella will own a 60 percent stake in this new company."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The remaining 40 percent will go t..."
entries.dialogueText: "The remaining 40 percent will go to Lespia."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The remaining 40 percent will go t..."
entries.dialogueText: "The remaining 40 percent will go to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The governments of Rizia and Lespi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The governments of Rizia and Lespia will receive a 20 percent stake each."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The government of Morella will own..."
entries.dialogueText: "The government of Morella will own an 80 percent stake in this company."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The remaining 20 percent will go t..."
entries.dialogueText: "The remaining 20 percent will go to Lespia."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Higher wages and stronger labor an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Higher wages and stronger labor and environmental protections will be implemented immediately."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hegel shook his head in disappointm..."
entries.dialogueText: Hegel shook his head in disappointment.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez smiled approvingly."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez smiled approvingly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The audience broke into animated wh..."
entries.dialogueText: The audience broke into animated whispers.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""However, this does not mean a comp..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, this does not mean a complete continuation of the status quo. While Rizia and Lespia will continue mining operations with a 25 percent share each, the Republic of Valgsland will be transferring its share to Morella."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I glanced at Alvarez. He gave me a..."
entries.dialogueText: I glanced at Alvarez. He gave me a look of warning.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez scowled."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez scowled.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez smiled patiently."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez smiled patiently.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Each MITZ partner must now give hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Each MITZ partner must now give his or her final approval to the proposal."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The Republic of Morella votes yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "The Republic of Morella votes yes."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Lespia votes yes as well. We look..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia votes yes as well. We look forward to building a fairer MITZ together with Morella."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Lespia votes no to the unfair seiz..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia votes no to the unfair seizure of our assets."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was my turn."
entries.dialogueText: It was my turn.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Kingdom of Rizia had no part i..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Kingdom of Rizia had no part in this proposal and we refuse to approve it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If the Republic of Morella deems t..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the Republic of Morella deems this proposal to be the best choice, I have no other option but to agree to it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Unfortunately, circumstances have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, circumstances have changed. Though I worked closely on this proposal with Morella, I can no longer agree to it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia votes yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia votes yes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia votes no.""
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia votes no."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia votes yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia votes yes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My kingdom is happy to approve thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "My kingdom is happy to approve this proposal."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both Saltana and Hegel stared at me..."
entries.dialogueText: Both Saltana and Hegel stared at me in abject shock.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Uh, thank you, King Romus... Chanc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Uh, thank you, King Romus... Chancellor Hegel?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana nodded at Hegel."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana nodded at Hegel.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both Saltana and Hegel gave satisfi..."
entries.dialogueText: Both Saltana and Hegel gave satisfied nods.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Valgslandian chancellor cleared..."
entries.dialogueText: The Valgslandian chancellor cleared his throat dramatically.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Thank you, King Romus... Chancello..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, King Romus... Chancellor Hegel?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The new agreement includes some ch..."
entries.dialogueText: "The new agreement includes some changes to the size of our partners' shares. But rest assured that nobody will be going home empty-handed.'

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Well... almost nobody.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well... almost nobody."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An aide approached Saltana with a b..."
entries.dialogueText: An aide approached Saltana with a briefcase. She opened it and took out a single piece of paper.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The Amended Meftiem International..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Amended Meftiem International Trade Zone Agreement of 1957."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""From henceforth, it is agreed that..."
entries.dialogueText: "From henceforth, it is agreed that the share of the MITZ previously belonging to Valgsland will be transferred to the Republic of Morella."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Higher wages and stronger labor an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Higher wages and stronger labor and environmental protections will be implemented immediately."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The other half of the Trade Zone w..."
entries.dialogueText: "The other half of the Trade Zone will belong to Lespia."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The other half of the Trade Zone w..."
entries.dialogueText: "The other half of the Trade Zone will belong to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Morella will also be taking over t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella will also be taking over the share previously belonging to Lespia. The other 25 percent of the Trade Zone will go to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Lespia and Rizia will retain their..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia and Rizia will retain their 25 percent shares."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Lespia will retain its 25 percent..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia will retain its 25 percent share, while Rizia will transfer a portion of its own to grant Morella majority ownership."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez smiled approvingly."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez smiled approvingly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I glanced at Alvarez. He gave me a..."
entries.dialogueText: I glanced at Alvarez. He gave me a look of warning.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez scowled and folded his arms..."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez scowled and folded his arms.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Each MITZ partner must now grant h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Each MITZ partner must now grant his or her final vote of approval to the proposal."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The Republic of Morella votes yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "The Republic of Morella votes yes."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Lespia votes yes as well. We look..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia votes yes as well. We look forward to building a fairer MITZ together with Morella."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Lespia approves as well.""
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia approves as well."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Lespia votes no to this unfair sha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia votes no to this unfair sham of an agreement."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was my turn."
entries.dialogueText: It was my turn.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Kingdom of Rizia had no part i..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Kingdom of Rizia had no part in this proposal and we refuse to approve it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If the Republic of Morella deems t..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the Republic of Morella deems this proposal to be the best choice, I have no other option but to agree to it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia votes yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia votes yes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia votes no.""
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia votes no."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Kingdom of Rizia gladly approv..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Kingdom of Rizia gladly approves this proposal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Unfortunately, circumstances have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, circumstances have changed. Though we worked very closely with Morella on this proposal, we can no longer agree to it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both Saltana and Hegel gave me shar..."
entries.dialogueText: Both Saltana and Hegel gave me sharp looks.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Uh, thank you, King Romus... Chanc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Uh, thank you, King Romus... Chancellor Hegel?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana nodded at Hegel."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana nodded at Hegel.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both Saltana and Hegel gave satisfi..."
entries.dialogueText: Both Saltana and Hegel gave satisfied nods.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Valgslandian chancellor cleared..."
entries.dialogueText: The Valgslandian chancellor cleared his throat dramatically.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Thank you, King Romus... Chancello..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, King Romus... Chancellor Hegel?"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""The Republic of Valgsland approves..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Republic of Valgsland approves this proposal."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a round of polite applaus..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a round of polite applause.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""The Republic of Valgsland cannot a..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Republic of Valgsland cannot approve this proposal."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""The Republic of Valgsland approves..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Republic of Valgsland approves this proposal."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Just as the door was being opened f..."
entries.dialogueText: Just as the door was being opened for us, an aide rushed up to Elena and whispered something in her ear.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her face turned white. She pulled m..."
entries.dialogueText: Her face turned white. She pulled me aside.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Your Majesty, there's been a new d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, there's been a new development."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Apparently Morella and Lespia have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Apparently Morella and Lespia have reached a last-minute accord."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""The nationalization proposal now g..."
entries.dialogueText: "The nationalization proposal now grants Lespia an additional 20 percent stake in the new MITZ. Leaving us with nothing."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""The renegotiated MITZ proposal now..."
entries.dialogueText: "The renegotiated MITZ proposal now splits the Trade Zone equally between the two countries. Leaving us with nothing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Alvarez double-crossed us? Why am..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alvarez double-crossed us? Why am I not surprised?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, shit.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, shit."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why am I only being informed now?..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why am I only being informed now? Heads will roll for this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let Lespia have its gold. Rizia is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let Lespia have its gold. Rizia is an energy superpower now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It doesn't matter. Hegel would nev..."
entries.dialogueText: "It doesn't matter. Hegel would never agree to such a thing."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It won't make much of a difference..."
entries.dialogueText: "It won't make much of a difference to our income. But being shut out by our own neighbor is terrible for our image."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Given the war, it was inevitable t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given the war, it was inevitable that Lespia would turn against us. I'm just disappointed that Morella went along with it."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It was always a possibility that L..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was always a possibility that Lespia would turn against us. I'm just disappointed that Morella went along with it."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I'm truly sorry. I did tell you it..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm truly sorry. I did tell you it would be a possibility."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I'm surprised Morella went along w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm surprised Morella went along with it, though."

entries.dialogueText: She let out a long sigh.

entries.title: Narrator: "We were about to enter the building..."
entries.dialogueText: We were about to enter the building when Chancellor Emmerich Hegel and the rest of the Valgish delegation walked past us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hegel looked me in the eye and nodd..."
entries.dialogueText: Hegel looked me in the eye and nodded in greeting, his expression unreadable.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic

entries.dialogueText: I nodded back.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't acknowledge him."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't acknowledge him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Chancellor. May I have a moment of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Chancellor. May I have a moment of your time?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good day, Mr. Hegel.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good day, Mr. Hegel."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I fully intend for it to be a good..."
entries.dialogueText: "I fully intend for it to be a good day, Mr. Toras."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stopped in his tracks."
entries.dialogueText: He stopped in his tracks.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""*One* moment.""
entries.dialogueText: "*One* moment."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I admire your commitment to our ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "I admire your commitment to our neighbor's welfare, Your Majesty. But I hope you're considering Rizia's as well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course I'm ready. It's not like..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course I'm ready. It's not like anything is going to change."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There had better not be any unplea..."
entries.dialogueText: "There had better not be any unpleasant surprises."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm ready to have this MITZ nonsen..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm ready to have this MITZ nonsense over with."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm ready for Morella to stop wast..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm ready for Morella to stop wasting my time. There's a war going on."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Saltana doesn't see it as nonsense.""
entries.dialogueText: "Saltana doesn't see it as nonsense."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Saltana doesn't see it as a waste.""
entries.dialogueText: "Saltana doesn't see it as a waste."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Not that it's any of my business,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not that it's any of my business, but this might be our last chance to nip the Malenyevist threat in the bud."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Some things have already changed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Some things have already changed."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Not any more than usual.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not any more than usual."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Her revolutionaries haven't posed..."
entries.dialogueText: "Her revolutionaries haven't posed much of a threat to Rizia yet. But anything can happen..."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Not that it's any of my business.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not that it's any of my business."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Trust me. I know the signs of a co..."
entries.dialogueText: "Trust me. I know the signs of a coming uprising when I see one..."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I really am getting too old for th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I really am getting too old for this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez nodded mechanically."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez nodded mechanically.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana gasped audibly. Alvarez did..."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana gasped audibly. Alvarez didn't look surprised.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a round of polite applaus..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a round of polite applause. Saltana smiled in obvious relief.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Morellan prime minister took a..."
entries.dialogueText: The Morellan prime minister took a moment to compose herself.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""It seems we do not have an agreeme..."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems we do not have an agreement after all. The Meftiem International Trade Zone will not be nationalized."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""By unanimous vote, the Meftiem Int..."
entries.dialogueText: "By unanimous vote, the Meftiem International Trade Zone nationalization plan will be implemented."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""By a 3-1 vote, the Meftiem Interna..."
entries.dialogueText: "By a 3-1 vote, the Meftiem International Trade Zone nationalization plan will be implemented."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""This is a momentous occasion. I th..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is a momentous occasion. I thank you all for joining us here today, and invite you to stay for celebrations."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""The Republic of Valgsland approves..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Republic of Valgsland approves this proposal."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""The Republic of Valgsland cannot a..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Republic of Valgsland cannot approve this proposal."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""The Republic of Valgsland approves..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Republic of Valgsland approves this proposal."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both Saltana and Alvarez stared at..."
entries.dialogueText: Both Saltana and Alvarez stared at him in abject shock.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a round of polite applaus..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a round of polite applause. Saltana smiled in obvious relief.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Morellan prime minister took a..."
entries.dialogueText: The Morellan prime minister took a moment to compose herself.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""This is a momentous occasion. I th..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is a momentous occasion. I thank you all for joining us here today, and invite you to stay for celebrations."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena cornered me as I came out of..."
entries.dialogueText: Elena cornered me as I came out of the room.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Well, Your Majesty? What was that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Your Majesty? What was that about?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Valgsland's cooperation has been s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Valgsland's cooperation has been secured."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No time to explain. Let's get to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "No time to explain. Let's get to the vote."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""None of your business, Ms. Werner.""
entries.dialogueText: "None of your business, Ms. Werner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just a friendly chat. Nothing more.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just a friendly chat. Nothing more."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""That's wonderful news. I'll refrai..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's wonderful news. I'll refrain from asking how."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We were ushered into the main confe..."
entries.dialogueText: We were ushered into the main conference hall. Elena split off for her seat as I was led to one of the four podiums onstage.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""The day we're 'friendly' with Chan..."
entries.dialogueText: "The day we're 'friendly' with Chancellor Hegel is the day I eat my own hat."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""All right. I'll refrain from pryin..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. I'll refrain from prying further."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What are you smiling about?""
entries.dialogueText: "What are you smiling about?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez gave a cordial nod as I too..."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez gave a cordial nod as I took my place next to him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez had a fake smile plastered..."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez had a fake smile plastered on his face as I took my spot next to him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez gave a gruff nod of acknowl..."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez gave a gruff nod of acknowledgement as I took my place next to him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enjoy the feeling, Mr. Prime Minis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enjoy the feeling, Mr. Prime Minister. You won't be happy for long."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Greetings, Mr. Alvarez.""
entries.dialogueText: "Greetings, Mr. Alvarez."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Greetings, Mr. Alvarez.""
entries.dialogueText: "Greetings, Mr. Alvarez."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope you haven't forgotten about..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you haven't forgotten about our arrangement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So, how will you be voting today?""
entries.dialogueText: "So, how will you be voting today?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I haven't forgotten about our arra..."
entries.dialogueText: "I haven't forgotten about our arrangement."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""How could I?""
entries.dialogueText: "How could I?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sordland, eh? Congratulations on t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland, eh? Congratulations on the new alliance."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His expression didn't change."
entries.dialogueText: His expression didn't change.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His eyes sparkled."
entries.dialogueText: His eyes sparkled.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Thank you, Your Majesty. This will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty. This will be a boon for all of us."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""And a real thorn in the side of Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "And a real thorn in the side of Madam Prime Minister over there."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""I hope you're happy with yourself..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you're happy with yourself today, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""What do you mean, Your Majesty?""
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""You'll find out soon, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "You'll find out soon, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Hello, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hello, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Good.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""You know the answer, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "You know the answer, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a squeal of feedback as A..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a squeal of feedback as Alma Saltana tapped on her microphone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The reporters, executives and vario..."
entries.dialogueText: The reporters, executives and various delegations in the conference hall snapped to attention.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Several years ago, the Republic of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Several years ago, the Republic of Morella began an initiative to bring the resources of the Meftiem Basin under the stewardship of our state and our people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She grimaced."
entries.dialogueText: She grimaced.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""That is not the only gesture of fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is not the only gesture of faith that Chancellor Emmerich Hegel has extended to us."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We are also pleased to announce th..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are also pleased to announce that Morella is now on a fast track for candidacy in the Contanan Security Pact."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We are thereby able to pledge that..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are thereby able to pledge that our half of the Trade Zone will be run with fairness and respect to both workers and the environment."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The chatter in the hall grew louder..."
entries.dialogueText: The chatter in the hall grew louder. I saw Prime Minister Alvarez bang a fist on his podium.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""First Sordland, now Morella... The..."
entries.dialogueText: "First Sordland, now Morella... The communists will eat our continent alive."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I suppose you won't be happy to kn..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose you won't be happy to know that I promised Caleqabiz to the CSP."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""The communists can try all they wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "The communists can try all they want. But they won't win."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We're keeping our gold mines. Just..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're keeping our gold mines. Just as we planned."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will oppose them with our dying..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will oppose them with our dying breath."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If that is what God wills... so be..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that is what God wills... so be it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't speak to me as if I am your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't speak to me as if I am your ally."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Let's hope it doesn't come to that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's hope it doesn't come to that, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""You did WHAT?!""
entries.dialogueText: "You did WHAT?!"

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""But for how long, Your Majesty? Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "But for how long, Your Majesty? This doesn't bode well for either of us."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Petty grudges mean nothing in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Petty grudges mean nothing in the greater battle between East and West, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Let's see if you can keep up that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's see if you can keep up that sanguine attitude when they come for your head."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She took a deep breath."
entries.dialogueText: She took a deep breath.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Unfortunately, not all stakeholder..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, not all stakeholders agreed on this new direction for the Trade Zone."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""But after several rounds of negoti..."
entries.dialogueText: "But after several rounds of negotiations, we were able to come to a compromise that preserved the MITZ's structure while introducing new measures."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""In this new agreement, each of our..."
entries.dialogueText: "In this new agreement, each of our partners are able to keep their existing share. Nobody will be going home empty-handed."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""The Republic of Valgsland cannot a..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Republic of Valgsland cannot approve this proposal."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few whispers rippled through the..."
entries.dialogueText: A few whispers rippled through the crowd. Saltana fixed the Valgslandian chancellor with a piercing stare.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a round of polite applaus..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a round of polite applause.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Whispers rippled through the crowd."
entries.dialogueText: Whispers rippled through the crowd.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""By unanimous vote, the renegotiate..."
entries.dialogueText: "By unanimous vote, the renegotiated agreement for the Meftiem International Trade Zone will be implemented."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""By a 3-1 vote, the renegotiated ag..."
entries.dialogueText: "By a 3-1 vote, the renegotiated agreement for the Meftiem International Trade Zone will be implemented."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""It seems we have a stalemate. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems we have a stalemate. The renegotiated agreement cannot be implemented."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few whispers rippled through the..."
entries.dialogueText: A few whispers rippled through the crowd. Saltana fixed Alvarez and myself with a piercing stare.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Whispers rippled through the crowd...."
entries.dialogueText: Whispers rippled through the crowd. The Morellan prime minister took a moment to compose herself.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Prime Minister Saltana waved at all..."
entries.dialogueText: Prime Minister Saltana waved at all of us to join her at her podium for a photograph.

entries.dialogueText: Saltana tapped on her mic once more.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Silence, please!""
entries.dialogueText: "Silence, please!"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Lespia and Rizia may still have ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia and Rizia may still have our gold. But they will never vanquish our spirit."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Valgsland, Sordland, Morella -- a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Valgsland, Sordland, Morella -- a new axis of solidarity is forming on this continent. It may not happen today, but the forces of justice will prevail."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""A new axis of solidarity is formin..."
entries.dialogueText: "A new axis of solidarity is forming on this continent. It may not happen today, but the forces of justice will prevail."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I applauded, ignoring Alvarez's dir..."
entries.dialogueText: I applauded, ignoring Alvarez's dirty look.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She didn't respond. Her eyes stayed..."
entries.dialogueText: She didn't respond. Her eyes stayed on the audience.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't react."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't react.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Justice? You will lead Merkopa int..."
entries.dialogueText: "Justice? You will lead Merkopa into ruin."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I will take questions shortly. For..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will take questions shortly. For now, please talk amongst yourselves."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The chatter in the hall grew louder..."
entries.dialogueText: The chatter in the hall grew louder. A few reporters jumped to their feet and began yelling questions.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana rushed off the stage, angri..."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana rushed off the stage, angrily motioning for Hegel to follow her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana rushed off the stage, motio..."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana rushed off the stage, motioning for Hegel to follow her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez turned to me with a thin-li..."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez turned to me with a thin-lipped smile.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""You made a deal with the devil. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "You made a deal with the devil. I hope it was worth it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To see the look on your face right..."
entries.dialogueText: "To see the look on your face right now? Yes, very much so."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't respond to his comment."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't respond to his comment.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If Hegel is the devil, you're evil..."
entries.dialogueText: "If Hegel is the devil, you're evil itself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I did no such thing. Your gambit l..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did no such thing. Your gambit lost, pure and simple."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No need for such remarks. We're al..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need for such remarks. We're all distinguished politicians here."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""The gloves are off, Your Majesty...."
entries.dialogueText: "The gloves are off, Your Majesty. Good luck in Pales."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a last scowl in my direction,..."
entries.dialogueText: With a last scowl in my direction, he left the stage.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""The gloves are off, Your Majesty...."
entries.dialogueText: "The gloves are off, Your Majesty. The best of luck to your kingdom."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez turned to me with a smile o..."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez turned to me with a smile of relief.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Well, that was painless. Thank you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, that was painless. Thank you for your cooperation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're welcome, Mr. Prime Minister.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're welcome, Mr. Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We've just driven Morella and Valg..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've just driven Morella and Valgsland closer to each other. That can't be good news."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't respond to his comment."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't respond to his comment.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Hmm. It's a good thing Lespia does..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm. It's a good thing Lespia doesn't share a border with either."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a small wave in my direction,..."
entries.dialogueText: With a small wave in my direction, he left the stage.

entries.dialogueText: As the shutters clicked aorund us, the Lespian prime minister cast a poisonous look back in my direction.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the shutters clicked around us,..."
entries.dialogueText: As the shutters clicked around us, he looked back in my direction and winked.
